cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(a6g_gz_worlds)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
# Generated by `uv run a6g campus build` (run it before colcon build).
install(DIRECTORY worlds maps models sim DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME} OPTIONAL)
ament_environment_hooks("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/env-hooks/${PROJECT_NAME}.dsv.in")
ament_package()
